name: content-engine-mcp
description: Local MCP content engine: seeds, citations, email-safe HTML, X intent links.
long_description: Turns an MCP-capable agent into a personal content engine. You write; the server structures, fact-checks, and renders a newsletter plus X, Instagram, and LinkedIn copy packs. No sampling. No social APIs.

project_folder.title: Project folder
project_folder.description: Folder where Content Engine stores voice, seeds, drafts, and calendar. Created on first run if it does not exist.
